supersedes.reason: The first native setup attempt exposed an early-v14 database whose governance schema did not satisfy the final strict v14 import contract. Development 011 automated evidence remains historical, but it did not prove native setup compatibility.

classification.rule: Classification validates the exact schema, indexes, foreign keys, and project integrity; user_version=14 alone is insufficient.

coverage: empty early-v14 repair with backup and idempotent reopen
populated governance-row preservation and composite foreign keys
unknown invalid v14 rejection without backup or mutation
transaction rollback restores the original pre-contract schema
unknown index and foreign-key shapes remain rejected
backup collision and insufficient-space guards preserve the original database

nativeAcceptance: Open the actual early-v14 library through existing-library mode and confirm the pre-v14-contract backup and SHA-256 are shown.
Confirm the repaired library opens with all papers, hotspots, memberships, review batches, and source-governance rows preserved.
Restart and reopen the same current-v14 library; no second compatibility backup or repair may occur.
Present an unknown malformed v14 fixture and confirm setup rejects it without mutation or backup.
Only after these checks may native compatibility be recorded as PASS; this evidence does not claim that result.
